claim: Google reports a 33x reduction in median Gemini prompt energy while its environmental report says data-centre electricity consumption rose 27% year over year, a concrete example of the rebound problem.
shortLabel: Efficiency gains do not settle demand growth
comparisonContext: This is one of the clearest concrete examples of why rebound effects remain central to the debate.
scopeNote: The 33x figure and the 27% figure come from different Google sources and should stay explicitly separated.
sourceTitle: Google research and Google environmental report
